name: Goleads
author: graficar2006

sections.installation:
1. Install the Plugin:
    • Upload the goleads folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the Plugin:
    • Navigate to the Plugins screen in your WordPress dashboard and activate “Goleads”.
  3. Register or Log In:
    • Go to the Goleads settings page in the WordPress admin (under “Goleads”).
    • Register a new Goleads account or log in with your existing Goleads credentials.
  4. Configure the Chatbot:
    • Customize the chatbot’s appearance, position, and behavior in the settings.
    • Sync your WordPress content (pages, posts, products, or WooCommerce settings) with the Goleads platform.
  5. Save and Test:
    • Save your settings and test the chatbot on your website to ensure it works as expected.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Goleads account to use this plugin?

Yes, you need a Goleads account to connect the plugin to the Goleads platform. You can register directly from the plugin’s settings page in WordPress.

What types of content can the chatbot sync?

The chatbot can sync WordPress pages, posts, WooCommerce products, and WooCommerce store settings to provide relevant responses to users.

Is the chatbot customizable?

Yes, you can customize the chatbot’s appearance (color, size, icon), position on the page, and conversational behavior through the plugin’s settings.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely! Goleads integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce, allowing the chatbot to access product details, prices, and other store information.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Deactivating the plugin will remove the chatbot from your website, but your Goleads account and synced data will remain intact on the Goleads platform.
